grammarRules: One statement per line. Strings use double quotes and backslash escapes. Emoji are bare tokens.
A screen starts with aui 1, then screen <snake_id> "Title" "Subtitle"? tint:<name>, then state base:<n> cur:USD only when items carry prices.
An answer omits screen and starts with summary "1–3 sentence answer".
Containers collect the item, point, field, column, row, or submit lines that follow them.
Actions come last: @send("message"), @nav("self-contained next-screen brief"), or @url(resource).
Detail pages come last: page "Exact tile title", then that page's sections. A page title must match a tile or comparison column title.

components.prompt: intro "text" — lede paragraph; markdown is allowed
components.sample: intro "A concise introduction."

components.prompt: header 🍪 "Title" "Subtitle"? — section heading with emoji art
components.sample: header ✨ "Example" "Useful detail"

components.prompt: hero img:"image search query" "Caption"? — full-bleed image header
components.sample: hero img:"example editorial photo" "Example"

components.prompt: button primary? "Label" @action — standalone CTA
components.sample: button primary "Continue" @send("Continue")

components.prompt: row "Title"? → item 🍔 "Title" "Subtitle"? img:"query" cap:"2024 · 8.5★"? badge:"New"? @action?
components.sample:
row "Examples"
item ✨ "Example" "Useful detail"

components.prompt: posters "Title"? → item "Dune: Part Two" img:"dune part two movie poster" cap:"2024 · 8.5★"? badge:"New"? @action? — 2:3 cover carousel
components.sample:
posters "Top picks"
item 🎬 "Example film" img:"example film poster"

components.prompt: menu "Title"? → item 🍔 "Classic Smash" "Double patty, secret sauce" price:12.50 img:"classic smash burger" badge:"Bestseller"? @action? — commerce rows; price required
components.sample:
menu "Menu"
item 🍔 "Classic" "House favorite" price:12.50

components.prompt: grid "Title"? → item 🍋 "Title" "Subtitle"? img:"query" badge:"New"? @action? — compact tiles
components.sample:
grid "What you need"
item 🍋 "Lemon" "One, juiced"

components.prompt: cards → item 🚗 "Title" "Positioning" img:"query" s:"Label=Value" s:"Label=Value" — 1–2 entity cards, at most 3 stats each
components.sample:
cards
item 🚗 "Example car" "Daily all-rounder" s:"Range=300 mi"

components.prompt: steps "Title"? → item 🔥 "Short title" "One-sentence detail"
components.sample:
steps "Method"
item 🔥 "Heat the pan" "Use medium heat."

components.prompt: facts "Title"? → item 🔌 "Road trip easy" "Supercharger access keeps charging simple." — icon-led product or place qualities
components.sample:
facts "Why it works"
item 🔌 "Easy to use" "Clear controls reduce friction."

components.prompt: bullets "Title"? check? → item "text; markdown is allowed"
components.sample:
bullets "Remember" check
item "Bring a charger."

components.prompt: stats "Title"? → item "8.5" "IMDb" trend:up? — value at most 8 characters, at most 4 subject facts
components.sample:
stats "At a glance"
item "8.5" "Rating" trend:up

components.prompt: expand "Title"? → item "Question" "Body"
components.sample:
expand "Details"
item "What is included?" "Everything shown above."

components.prompt: chips → item "Label ≤ 4 words" "Full prompt sent on tap"
components.sample:
chips
item "Show me more" "Show me more examples"

components.prompt: sources → item "Title" url:r1 — cite only a DATA resource id used in the answer
components.sample:
sources
item "Official source" url:r1

components.prompt: list "Title"? pick:<group>|multi → item 🥐 "Brioche" "Buttery" val:brioche price:0 sel? — single-select or toggleable options
components.sample:
list "Choose one" pick:choice
item ✨ "Example" "Included" val:example price:0 sel

components.prompt: receipt "Title"? → item "1× Classic Smash" price:14.50 — client appends the computed Total row; omit state base
components.sample:
receipt "Order"
item "1× Example" price:14.50

components.prompt: compare 🥊 → 2–3 col "Contender" img:"exact contender photo" lines, optional cgroup "Group", then crow "Metric" "a" "b" win:1|2? n1:"Short edge"? n2:"Short edge"?
components.sample:
compare 🥊
col "A"
col "B"
cgroup "Essentials"
crow "Range" "350 mi" "320 mi" win:1

components.prompt: chart line|bar "Title" unit:"Grounded unit" → 2–12 ordered X labels and 1–3 complete series using point "X label" "Series" v:<number>. Use line only for an ordered trend and grouped bars for category comparisons. Every value and the unit must appear in DATA or the user's message; never infer missing points, mix units, stack bars, or chart a single value.
components.sample:
chart line "Weekly focus" unit:"min"
point "Mon" "Focus" v:42
point "Tue" "Focus" v:55
components.supportedPrompt: use line or grouped-bar charts only when 2–12 grounded values make a trend or category comparison clearer; emit a complete value for every X label in every series and keep one unit across the chart.
components.unsupportedPrompt: NEVER emit chart or point; use stats for headline values and table, row, facts, or bullets for the underlying data instead.

components.prompt: table "Title"? → 2–4 tcol "Header" lines, then trow "Cell" "Cell" hi? — neutral standings, schedules, scoreboards, or compact matrices
components.sample:
table "Standings"
tcol "Team"
tcol "Pts"
trow "Auri FC" "74" hi
components.supportedPrompt: use it when neutral multi-column data is the clearest shape.
components.unsupportedPrompt: NEVER emit table, tcol, or trow; use row, facts, stats, or bullets instead.

components.prompt: form <snake_id> "Title" cap:nav|send confirm:"Confirmation question" → 1–6 field lines, then submit "Label" @matching_action. Fields: field text|textarea <snake_id> "Label" placeholder:"…"? val:"…"? required? min:<chars>? max:<chars>?; field select <snake_id> "Label" opt:"value=Label" opt:"value=Label" val:<value>? required?; field date <snake_id> "Label" val:YYYY-MM-DD required?; field slider <snake_id> "Label" min:<n> max:<n> step:<n> val:<n>? unit:"…"?. Use forms only to refine a search or collect details for a real listed capability; never request passwords, payment, booking, health, or other sensitive data.
components.sample:
form refine_search "Refine search" cap:nav confirm:"Search with these details?"
field text query "Search terms" placeholder:"What are you looking for?" required min:2 max:80
field select timeframe "Time frame" opt:"any=Any time" opt:"week=Past week" val:any
submit "Show results" @nav("Results for {query} from {timeframe}")
components.supportedPrompt: emit a form only when its cap names an available ability marked for form submissions; keep it to 1–6 non-sensitive fields and make the submit action match cap.
components.unsupportedPrompt: NEVER emit form, field, or submit; use lists, chips, or a normal button instead.

components.prompt: tabs → 2–4 tab "Title" blocks containing sections, then end — depth 1; never place tabs inside a page
components.sample:
tabs
tab "First"
intro "First option."
tab "Second"
intro "Second option."
end
